root_causes.description: hermes kanban create defaults to status=ready when --initial-status is not specified
Dispatcher auto-assigned deep-implementer via kanban.default_assignee and immediately spawned
No policy enforced intake parent cards to be created with --initial-status blocked or non-spawnable assignee
kanban-card-spec and kanban-watch live at hermes-agent/skills/kanban/ which is not in worker skill search path (~/.hermes/skills/ or ~/.hermes/custom-skills/)
kanban-card-spec and kanban-watch are operator/workflow skills placed in card skills field which propagates to --skills CLI arg for workers

mitigation: Card blocked via official Hermes/Kanban CLI

canonical_fix.intake_parent_create_command: hermes kanban --board agent-garden create --title 'Stage 1 Intake — <issue>' --initial-status blocked --skills prism-full --body '<body with workflow metadata>'
